_what_this_is: THE FIGURE-AMENDMENTS REGISTER. A declared figure in an ARCHIVED brief is
accepted when the producer re-executes it as of the brief's own date. That
pins the DENOMINATOR -- the corpus as it stood -- and it cannot absorb a
NUMERATOR change caused by a RULE changing underneath the record.
NEITHER HORN OF THE DILEMMA IS TAKEN. The archived brief is NEVER edited,
because editing it falsifies the record of what the seats were given; and
archived briefs are NOT exempted, because an exemption is a hole. Instead
an amendment is RECORDED here, and the figure is accepted only when the
named producer re-executes the REPLACEMENT value as of the brief's date.
RULE-SET PINNING WAS CONSIDERED AND REJECTED, by both panel seats
independently in the star round of 2026-10-03: keeping superseded gate
implementations executable forever forks the predicate at every ruling, and
a fork that must stay runnable is a second implementation to keep correct.
IT CANNOT LAUNDER AN EDIT. Every entry carries BOTH the superseded and the
replacement value, they must DIFFER, and the replacement must be what the
producer actually prints -- checked by execution, not by reading. An entry
whose replacement does not re-execute is REFUSED, loudly, and fails closed.

amendments.figure_label: archived falsifier rejections that are NOT location artefacts
amendments.ruling: Founder: "Just make it accurate. If a key was accessed and read, report it at the end of a run." The pre-execution key gate was narrowed to ACCESS-ONLY.
amendments.why: C0015 left the real-rejection set because it reads NOTHING: 0 violations, its only key-ish content the word 'planted' inside a message printed to a human. It was refused for NAMING a plant while reading nothing, which the archive guard's own docstring calls 'the rule is blocking honest work'. The corpus is identical; the rule moved under the record.
amendments._note_on_the_values: These are the DECLARED forms, exactly as the brief writes them, because the validator compares against the declaration. A bare '2/640' would not match the declaration and the amendment would silently never apply.
